facts.description: This flaw makes curl overflow a heap based buffer in the SOCKS5 proxy handshake. When curl is asked to pass along the host name to the SOCKS5 proxy to allow that to resolve the address instead of it getting done by curl itself, the maximum length that host name can be is 255 bytes. If the host name is detected to be longer, curl switches to local name resolving and instead passes on the resolved address only.

indicator.value: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

verdict.headline: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') (CWE-79) is a software weakness in MITRE CWE, with a high likelihood of exploit.

facts.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
facts.description:
The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page.

There are many flavors of XSS: Reflected XSS Stored XSS
broader_weakness: CWE-74 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
consequences: Access Control, Confidentiality: Bypass Protection Mechanism, Read Application Data
how_to_prevent: Architecture and Design: Use a vetted library or framework that does not allow this weakness to occur.
Implementation: Use and specify an output encoding that can be handled by the downstream component.
